visit.title: Seeing a specialist, step by step

steps.title: Book a serial
steps.body: Call the hotline or message us on WhatsApp with the doctor's name. The desk confirms the day and your serial.

steps.title: Bring your papers
steps.body: Arrive 15 minutes early with old prescriptions, reports and X-ray or scan films.

steps.title: Tests in the same building
steps.body: Lab, imaging and the pharmacy are on site, so most tests can be done the same day.
